comparison.batch_rule: identical train batch prefix through the minimum completed epoch of each pair
comparison.capacity: MLP matches 6144 added parameters, not FLOPs. Level/change have 4096; no-static removes4096. No memory-history interaction claim.
comparison.failed_gates: retain each dataset/metric failure; do not exclude datasets or revise thresholds
comparison.historical_results: exploratory context only; legacy head and 120-epoch runs not final-table rows
comparison.initialization: B/Full/common new-arm tensors and post-construction RNG identical per seed; no-static excludes only lmm tensors
comparison.primary: Full versus equal-added-parameter adjacent-history MLP; then level/change necessity and conditional static retrieval necessity
comparison.scope: three datasets x seeds42,52,62; validation only; reusable B/Full from completed 300/40/40 campaign
comparison.selector: all selected quantity/time/stratum metrics use the SAME raw-RMSE-selected checkpoint
comparison.stability: last30 separately plus fixed first40-epoch window; differing stop epochs disclosed
comparison.tuning: no model-specific hyperparameter search in this controlled comparison

cost_estimate.excludes: preparation, qualification, replay; architecture throughput and stopping may differ
cost_estimate.resource_cap: New reduced scope: each host at most 120 wall hours from shared permit including qualification; at most 240 aggregate GPU-hours. All-300 completion is not guaranteed.
